name: Reversis
summary: Old French trick-avoiding card game in the Hearts family where you try to win the fewest points, unless you can take all tricks.
rules_text: Reversis is for 4 players (5 with fewer cards) with a 52-card French pack, later 48 cards without Tens, ranking A K Q J 9-2, no trumps, deal and play anticlockwise. Each of 13 tricks: follow suit if able, otherwise discard any card; highest card of led suit wins trick and leads next. Counting cards are A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1 (earlier 5-4-3-2) total 40, plus the Jack of Hearts called Quinola is special. After all tricks points are totaled; normally the player with fewest points wins and is paid the talon by the player with most points. If a player makes the reversis by taking every trick, that slam reverses the aim and that player wins outright, sweeping pools and reclaiming side payments. Bonuses for discarding Quinola and penalties for being forced to play it were added in later variants.
rating_reason: Classic trick-avoidance card game, fits hidden hands sequential
